title: Friction compounding factor F for digested sludge
applicability: Step 5 of the same printed procedure: the digested-sludge form of the friction compounding factor used after the Manning friction loss is calculated as for water.
notes: Ep527-2 is a service locator, not a printed equation number.
Printed as '5.  F for digested sludge is = 1.52 + (0.041×P×P) – (0.227×P)'. As in step 4 the word 'is' precedes '=' and the square term is printed 'P×P'; both retained.
Step 6 of the same list prints 'Allow for an additional factor of safety of 10%.' with no formula; it is not transcribed as an equation.
P is given no unit in the printed list; none is added.
The two forms differ only in their coefficients and constants (2.88 / 0.176 / 0.866 for undigested sludge, 1.52 / 0.041 / 0.227 for digested sludge); no algebraic simplification is applied.

transcription.method: Direct viewing of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page renders and 260-800 dpi crops of the same pages; no OCR, no paid service
